info.title: MICROSERVICE-PROD-Create Wholesale Trading Quote Management-spec
info.description: The Wholesale Trading Quote Management API facilitates the creation and management of trading quotes in the wholesale sector. This API enables users to submit new quotes, streamline trading processes, and enhance collaboration between traders and clients. It targets stakeholders such as financial institutions, trading firms, and brokers who need efficient systems for handling price quotations. By utilizing this API, users can improve operational efficiency and ensure quick response times in trading activities.

post.description: This endpoint allows users to create a new quote within the wholesale trading system. It captures essential information for pricing and order details that are utilized in the sales processes.

requestBody.description: Request body for creating or updating quote management operations within the wholesale trading context. This operation allows the client to submit detailed information regarding quotes, including relevant parameters for processing.

201.description: Resource successfully created, indicating the quote has been generated.
